selector.rationale: The presence of hyperkeratosis, distinct vacuolization in the granular and upper spinous layers, and bullae formation within the epidermis, along with a heterozygous variation in KRT1, supports Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis

rejected.label: Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma
rejected.why: While it shares some clinical features, the specific histopathological findings and genetic variation point more strongly towards Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis
